author: Boredindaoffice
quote:
Good work Rockstar you have ruined what was once an amazing franchise. Your corporate greed and woke bs has put the final nail in the coffin. 

Please reform the original writing team, we can’t have another game like this. I were looking forward to running down some protestors and causing mayhem in vice city. All the fun has been removed from the game.

 This is no longer the GTA we all loved. RIP
